input.quote: This Agreement shall be automatically renewed for an additional one year period on each anniversary of the Effective Date, unless terminated by either Party hereto upon ninety (90) days written notice to the other. Such notice shall specify the date on which this Agreement is to be terminated (the "Termination Date").
input.rationale: Section 4 addresses only the term, the 90-day termination notice and the Termination Payment (pp. 4.1-4.2(c)); nothing anywhere in the Agreement requires HDI to assist us in migrating the Site or to hand back our data on exit. Section 1.4/1.5 give the Company access to HDI's systems and order export files only "for the term of this Agreement" / for order collection during operations, and the survival clause (10.7) lists Sections 6.3, 7, 9 and 10 only. HDI hosts the Site on its own server (1.3, 1.7) and holds our Content, user information and transaction data (8.1), so on exit we would be dependent on HDI's goodwill for both continuity and data recovery — the rule's walk-away risk (no data return). Because no usable transition or data-return clause exists, we insert a new Section 4.3 at the preferred position: up to six (6) months of transition assistance at HDI's then-current rates, return of our Content, user information and transaction data in a commonly used machine-readable format within thirty (30) days of expiry or termination, and certified deletion thereafter. The fallback (90 days of assistance with the same 30-day export) is offered in the comment.

proposal.summary: Insert Section 4.3 requiring HDI to provide up to six months of transition assistance at then-current rates, return Company data in machine-readable form within 30 days of expiry or termination, and certify deletion thereafter.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 4 covers only termination notice and the Termination Payment, so we have added a transition and data-return provision: up to six (6) months of assistance at HDI's then-current rates, return of our Content, user information and transaction data in a machine-readable format within thirty (30) days, and certified deletion thereafter. If six months is too long, we can accept ninety (90) days of assistance with the same 30-day export.

ops.text: Transition Assistance; Return of Data. Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement for any reason, HDI shall (a) at the Company's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six (6) months at HDI's then-current rates; (b) within thirty (30) days after such expiry or termination, return all Content, user information and transaction data of the Company in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (c) thereafter delete such Content, information and data from its systems and certify such deletion in writing to the Company.

mappings.element: Transition obligations apply on expiry or termination.
Vendor provides transition assistance for up to six months.
Transition assistance is charged at then-current rates.
Vendor returns Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
Customer Data is returned in a standard machine-readable format.
Vendor certifies deletion of Customer Data after its return.
